entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eleuterio Maisonnave y Cutayar was a Spanish politician who served as minister of state in 1873 during the presidency of Francisco Pi y Margall in the First Spanish Republic. In 1885 he bought a daily newspaper, El Globo, based in Madrid.
